line: Four bridge types are tested on one briefing wall, and the ship that must pass under picks the winner.
line_cn: 一条河要架桥，四种桥型在一面简报墙上逐个受检，拍板的是桥下要过的船。

camera.move: Ride a line (with the pen or a dimension)
camera.serves: lengths compared; a route; a timeline

camera.expresses: the same quantity in another view
camera.serves: plan → elevation; a total → its parts
a collision; a deadline; an overrun

camera.expresses: stepping back to state a rule
camera.serves: a constraint; a turn in the argument

camera.move: Whip with the line, overshoot, settle
Staircase framing (each new item with the previous result)
Judgement frame: the whole item, the limit and the verdict, held ≥ 2.5 s
camera.expresses: a test the viewer can check
camera.serves: pass / fail against a threshold; a budget against a cap

camera.move: Long pull-back to the whole wall
camera.serves: the end of an argument; a summary

labels: Marker lettering: a single-weight marker face covering every script the film uses (ours: LXGW Marker Gothic, OFL, subset — re-run when words change). Content 100–160 board px; a verdict 230–400.
Printed labels (tags, cards, stamps): a sturdy sans; credit lines in a monospace. A tag holds one to three words.

Subtitles: a frosted acrylic strip at the bottom centre with a blue marker tick. If the film is bilingual, the film's language sits on top. One line per language: nowrap, measured in the page against a 1,500 px safe width; a long line becomes two cues. Key content stays above the strip (bottom 15 %).

Reading time: subtitles ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s); board text stays fully in frame for CJK ÷ 4.5 + other ÷ 15 + 1.5 s from when it appears. In the final wall, text meant to be read is ≥ 20 px on screen.
motion: 24 fps on ones; nothing is stepped.
Camera: overlapping eased moves, velocity ∝ u^a (1−u)^b (a, b ≈ 1.5–4), so speed and acceleration never jump; b > a gives inertia. A hand-held breath (≤ 3 px) underneath; shake only on an impact.

Weight: prints are lowered from the camera side, land, bounce and settle as the shadow tightens; magnets clack on to pin them; tags swing; removed magnets pop toward the lens; struck things jolt and spring back. The camera may meet a landing close, briefly, on the object's most telling detail, then pulls out.
Blurred in motion, sharp where words are read. Every 1–2 beats something lands, draws or swings; only silences and judgement holds go still.

native_moves.name: The whole-wall reveal
native_moves.does: Design the wall as a poster first (hierarchy, reading path, filling the frame), then plan every shot as a crop of it; keep one zone (secondary layer, verdict, title card) for the reveal alone. Fits: a product roadmap; a household budget.

native_moves.name: The subject passes through the answer
native_moves.does: The real thing moves through the chosen solution, its sound first. Fits: a parcel along the chosen route; a train over the new viaduct.

native_moves.name: Ride the dimension line
native_moves.does: A quantity drawn as a real length to one scale; the camera rides the tip. Fits: battery ranges of four cars.

native_moves.name: Projection lines
native_moves.does: Dashed lines carry an edge from one view to another so two drawings share a scale. Fits: a trail map above its elevation profile.

native_moves.name: Magnets as countable things
native_moves.does: Units clack on in rhythm, pop off when a rule removes them. Fits: seats in a vote.

native_moves.name: Erase to a ghost
native_moves.does: A rejected idea wiped but faintly visible. Fits: last year's plan under this year's.

native_moves.name: The stamp
native_moves.does: A verdict lands with a thud and a jolt. Fits: passed / failed tests.

native_moves.name: The physical answer
native_moves.does: A real prop laid down as the solution. Fits: one cable instead of five.

native_moves.name: Leader to the verdict
native_moves.does: An arrow from the deciding number to the conclusion. Fits: the bottleneck in a process.

score.note: small rhythmic ensemble, walking to brisk; low brass for verdicts
